about: Opie's starter recipes: put in a new household's recipe box once (bridge/house/recipes.js), marked as starters so they can be taken out like any other. Written for Opie; plain weeknight dishes in the box's cooking-steps shape (bridge/cooking.js parseCook); dish: its drawn mark where it has no photo (bridge/kit/dish-look.js).

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil if you like an easy clean-up.

steps.title: Toss the potatoes
steps.text: On the baking sheet, toss the potatoes, onion and garlic with 2 tbsp of the olive oil, half the salt and the pepper. Spread them out in one layer.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.text: Pat the chicken dry. Rub it with the rest of the oil, the oregano and the rest of the salt, then grate the lemon's zest over it. Set the pieces skin side up on top of the potatoes.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Cut the zested lemon in quarters and tuck them in around the chicken. Roast until the skin is golden and crisp.

steps.title: Add the beans
steps.text: Scatter the green beans into the gaps, turning them in the pan juices. Roast until the chicken reaches 175°F (80°C) inside and the beans are tender.

steps.title: Squeeze and serve
steps.text: Squeeze the roasted lemon over everything and spoon the pan juices over the chicken before serving.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Warm the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot and celery, stirring now and then, until soft and starting to turn golden.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.text: Add the garlic and cook for a minute. Add the beef and turn the heat up a little, breaking it into small pieces, until it has lost its pink color.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the tomato paste and cook for a minute, then add the crushed tomatoes, milk, herbs and salt. The milk makes the sauce softer and less sharp.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Bring it to a gentle bubble, then turn the heat low, partly cover and simmer, stirring now and then, until thick. Taste and add salt if it needs it.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.text: While the sauce simmers, cook the spaghetti in a big pot of well-salted boiling water until just tender. Save a mug of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Toss the spaghetti with about half the sauce and a splash of the cooking water so it coats every strand. Serve with the rest of the sauce on top and Parmesan at the table.

steps.title: Set out the toppings
steps.text: Put the lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sour cream, salsa and lime in bowls on the table, so everyone can build their own.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef and break it up as it cooks, until browned all over. Spoon off most of the fat.

steps.title: Season it
steps.text: Sprinkle in the chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder and salt and stir for 30 seconds, then pour in the water. Simmer, stirring, until the liquid is nearly gone and the meat is glossy.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for about 20 seconds a side, or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave for 30 seconds. Keep them wrapped so they stay soft.

steps.title: Fill and eat
steps.text: Spoon the beef into the tortillas and let everyone add their toppings, with a squeeze of lime.

ingredients.item: cooked rice, cold (best from the day before)
green onions, sliced, whites and greens apart

steps.title: Loosen the rice
steps.text: Break the cold rice up with your fingers so there are no clumps. Rice cooked the day before and chilled fries best; freshly cooked rice turns mushy.

uses.item: cooked rice, cold (best from the day before)

steps.title: Scramble the eggs
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Beat the eggs, pour them in and stir until just set. Tip them onto a plate.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Add another 1 tbsp oil, then the onion whites, garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Add the pepper and the peas and carrots and stir-fry until hot and just tender.

uses.item: green onions, sliced, whites and greens apart

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.text: Add the last 1 tbsp oil and the rice. Spread it out and let it sit for a minute so it toasts, then stir and repeat a few times until every grain is hot.

steps.title: Season and finish
steps.text: Pour the soy sauce around the edge of the pan, stir in the eggs, breaking them up, and take it off the heat. Stir in the sesame oil and the onion greens.

uses.item: green onions, sliced, whites and greens apart

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.text: If you're having rice, start it now so it's ready with the curry.

steps.title: Cook the onion
steps.text: Warm the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion until soft and golden at the edges.

steps.title: Toast the spices
steps.text: Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and cumin and stir for a minute, until it smells toasty. Add a splash of water if it starts to stick.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook, stirring now and then, until the sauce thickens a little.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until it wilts. Squeeze in the lime, taste and add salt if needed. Serve over rice or with warm naan.

steps.title: Cook the macaroni
steps.text: Cook the macaroni in a pot of salted boiling water until just tender. Drain it and set it aside.

steps.title: Make the sauce base
steps.text: In the same pot over medium heat, melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook for a minute without letting it brown.

steps.title: Add the milk
steps.text: Whisk in the milk a little at a time so it stays smooth. Keep stirring until it bubbles and thickens enough to coat a spoon.

steps.title: Melt in the cheese
steps.text: Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheese, salt and mustard until melted and smooth.

steps.title: Stir and serve
steps.text: Stir the macaroni back in until every piece is coated. If it gets thick, loosen it with a splash of milk. Serve right away.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Rinse the rice, then bring it to a boil with the water in a covered pot. Turn the heat to low and cook until the water is absorbed, then let it stand, covered, off the heat.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment.

steps.title: Mix the glaze
steps.text: Stir together the soy sauce, honey, garlic and vinegar in a small bowl.

steps.title: Fill the sheet
steps.text: Set the salmon skin side down on one side of the sheet and spoon half the glaze over it. Toss the broccoli with the oil and a pinch of salt and spread it on the other side.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until the salmon flakes easily in the thickest part and the broccoli has crisp edges.

steps.title: Glaze and serve
steps.text: Spoon the rest of the glaze over the salmon, scatter the sesame seeds on top and serve with the rice and broccoli.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Warm the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook until the onion is soft. Stir in the garlic for the last minute.

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.text: Pour in the broth, add the whole pieces of chicken, the thyme and the bay leaf. Bring to a boil, then lower to a gentle simmer until the chicken is cooked through.

steps.title: Shred the chicken
steps.text: Lift the chicken out onto a board and shred it with two forks. Take out the bay leaf.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Bring the soup back to a boil, add the noodles and cook until tender.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Return the chicken to the pot with the parsley. Taste and season with salt and pepper, then ladle into bowls.

steps.title: Cook the onion
steps.text: Melt 2 tbsp of the butter in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until soft but not brown.

steps.title: Simmer the tomatoes
steps.text: Add the tomatoes with their juice, the broth, sugar and salt. Crush the tomatoes with a spoon and simmer gently.

steps.title: Blend smooth
steps.text: Take the pot off the heat and blend the soup until smooth, with a stick blender or carefully in batches. Stir in the cream and keep it warm on low.

steps.title: Make the sandwiches
steps.text: Butter one side of each slice of bread with the rest of the butter. Make four sandwiches with the cheese inside and the buttered sides out.

steps.title: Grill them
steps.text: Cook the sandwiches in a skillet over medium-low heat until deep golden underneath, then turn and cook the other side until the cheese has melted.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut the sandwiches into strips for dipping and serve with bowls of the soup.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Butter a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan, or line it with parchment.

steps.title: Mash the bananas
steps.text: In a large bowl, mash the bananas with a fork until mostly smooth, with a few small lumps left.

steps.title: Mix the wet
steps.text: Stir in the melted butter, then the brown sugar, egg and vanilla until well mixed.

steps.title: Fold in the dry
steps.text: Sprinkle the baking soda, salt and cinnamon over the bowl and stir them in. Add the flour and fold just until no dry flour shows; a few streaks are fine. Fold in the nuts or chips if using.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Scrape the batter into the pan and bake until risen and deep golden, and a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn it out onto a rack. It slices best once it's nearly cool.
